hook.line: Most websites will never own a Google AI Overview answer, and here's why.
hook.visual: Bearded man in a floral shirt, chest-up, night city lights behind; a fixed white title on top reads 'Why 99% of websites are NEVER shown in AI Overview'; he raises a lav mic.

beats.what: Pinned top title states the 99% claim; he starts talking at 0.5 s
Defines AEO as Answer Engine Optimization; keyword highlighted in cyan in the caption
Contrast: SEO ranks a site, AEO becomes the answer shown before the click
Lists what answer content needs: direct answers, easy for Google's AI, shows expertise
Warning: a site optimized only for rankings misses the opportunity
Teases tomorrow's video on GEO and getting ChatGPT to recommend you
Asks viewers to follow for daily SEO and AI tips

why_it_works: A permanent top title restates the hook, so a viewer who drops in at any second knows the topic
Two-word caption chunks with one cyan keyword make the key terms (answer, optimization) readable on mute
Ends by promising a next-day part on GEO, giving a concrete reason to follow rather than a generic ask
weaknesses: One unbroken 57 s shot with no cuts, zooms or graphics; only the voice carries attention
Title says 99% while he says 'most', a claim with no proof shown
Explains AEO abstractly with no example of an actual AI Overview answer
for_robert: Pin a short title at the top for the whole reel and promise tomorrow's part at the end; but add what this lacks, e.g. Fred popping in to point at the AI Overview example he is describing.
